study type: secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) requiring medication (A2 GDM)
GDM well controlled by diet (A1 GDM)
outcome: any breastfeeding rates at hospital discharge
any breastfeeding rates at 3 months postpartum
cohort: The study included 600 patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), enrolled during their delivery hospitalization.
finding: There was no significant difference in any or exclusive breastfeeding rates at hospital discharge or 3 months postpartum among patients with A2 GDM compared with those with A1 GDM after adjusting for baseline differences.
